title: How Much Rain Fell?
style: calm luminous paper-cut watercolour science storybook

pages.text: A rain gauge catches the rain. Its scale tells us how many millimetres of rain fell.

quickWords.th: เครื่องวัดฝน

pages.text: One millimetre of rain is one litre of water on every square metre.
Ten millimetres of rain gives ten litres on every square metre.

quickWords.th: สิบมิลลิเมตร

pages.text: Rain can fall fast or slow. Fast rain is called heavy rain. Slow rain is light rain.

quickWords.th: ฝนเล็กน้อย

pages.text: The rain adds up. The total is accumulated rainfall. First five, then ten more, then fifteen more.

quickWords.th: ปริมาณฝนสะสม

pages.text: A short heavy shower and a long gentle rain can give the same total.

quickWords.th: ฝนตกช่วงสั้น ๆ
ฝนตกเบา ๆ

pages.text: When the news says one hundred millimetres, picture one hundred litres on every square metre.

quickWords.th: หนึ่งร้อยมิลลิเมตร
หนึ่งร้อยลิตร

pages.text: Weather stations across Thailand measure the rain.

quickWords.th: สถานีตรวจอากาศ

pages.text: Next time it rains, we can read our own rain gauge.
